## Database gate
- No schema, entity, index, or table shape changes detected.
- Migration `backend/migrations/246_enable_gemini_image_generation_groups.sql` adds an idempotent data update: it enables `groups.allow_image_generation` for existing `gemini` and `antigravity` groups. This is production DML and was not executed.
- Read-only production check:
  `SELECT platform, allow_image_generation, COUNT(*) FROM groups WHERE platform IN ('gemini', 'antigravity') GROUP BY platform, allow_image_generation ORDER BY platform, allow_image_generation;`
- If the product policy requires existing groups to inherit the new default, take a database backup and apply the migration manually, then verify the affected row counts. The application and repository checks do not replace that production verification.

## Conflict resolution
- CI workflows retain the Custom candidate-tree, delta-ledger, shadow-map, actionlint, and release provenance gates; official Go `1.27.3` checks and target cache restoration were added where compatible.
- Gemini native routing retains Custom channel-mapping binding and security/model-access checks, plus the official image-generation permission gate.
- Antigravity Claude and compatibility routing retain Custom resolved-model access enforcement, plus the official image-generation permission gate.
